newsitem.title: USA: S&P ups Philadelphia, Pa., GO bond rating to BBB.
newsitem.headline: S&P ups Philadelphia, Pa., GO bond rating to BBB.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said Tuesday it raised its rating on Philadelphia, Pa.'s $639.5 million general obligation bonds, as well as its rating on South Eastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority's $47.6 million lease revenue bonds Series 1968 issued for Philadelphia, to BBB from BBB-minus.
S&P said the outlook is stable.
S&P said the upgrade reflects a trend of sound financial operations, with five consecutive years of balanced operations.
Those factors are constrained, however, by weak economic trends, declining assessed valuations, a large underfunded pension, and a high debt burden due to deficit financing, S&P said.
